title: Number of Connected Components in an Undirected Graph
description:
There are `n` nodes labeled `0` to `n - 1` and a list of **undirected** edges, where `edges[i] = [a, b]` joins nodes `a` and `b`.

Return the number of **connected components** in the graph (groups of nodes that can reach each other).
constraints: 1 <= edges.length <= 5000 (an empty list is also accepted in the tests)
There are no self-loops and no repeated edges.
hints: Start with n components. Every edge that joins two different components reduces the count by one.
Union-find tracks the components; a DFS from each unvisited node works too.
